rules.priority: P1 = used by an M row, P2 = S, P3 = C; a dependency takes the priority of its earliest user
rules.order: P1 for all 25 games round-robin, then P2, then P3
rules.prompts: text only, generic, written for this plan, with the game's palette and material mood; no brands, teams, real places, named characters or titles
rules.textToThreeD: preview (latest model) then refine with --texture-resolution 2k --enable-pbr true --remove-lighting true
rules.retexture: local GLB through the CLI's local-file path (data URI), --enable-original-uv true --enable-pbr true --texture-resolution 2k
rules.rig: meshy rigging --height-meters; basic walk/run clips merged with assets merge-clips
rules.animate: one meshy animate task per clip on the rig task, merged with assets merge-clips, then assets validate-animation --require-rig
